admission_requirements.general_requirements: Secondary school certificate (Tawjihi) or equivalent; minimum marks vary by major: 60% for arts/science/IT/education/design/media, 65% for law, 70% for allied medical/nursing, 75% for sharia, 80% for engineering/pharmacy/dentistry
admission_requirements.exam_details: No entrance exam; admission based on Tawjihi marks. Level placement exams may be required for some programs.
admission_requirements.english_requirement: No specific TOEFL/IELTS requirement stated; English language courses are offered through the British Council for students needing improvement.

tuition_fees.annual_fees_range: Varies by major and nationality (after discounts for Jordanians); international students pay higher rates
tuition_fees.notes: Fees per credit hour (2024/2025): Sharia 30 JOD, Arts 55 JOD, Science 55 JOD, IT 65-80 JOD, Economics 50-60 JOD, Education 55-60 JOD, Law 60 JOD, Allied Medical 70-100 JOD, Nursing 70 JOD, Engineering 110-120 JOD, Pharmacy 120 JOD, Dentistry 290 JOD, Arts & Design 90 JOD, Media 80 JOD. Discounts up to 70% available for high achievers. The university offers scholarships totaling approximately JD 2.5 million per term.

ranking_accreditation.national_ranking: 8th in Jordan (ARU Arab Ranking for Universities 2025)
ranking_accreditation.accreditation: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research of Jordan (MOHE), Accreditation and Quality Assurance Commission for Higher Education Institutions, ASIC (British Accreditation Commission) Premier University status
ranking_accreditation.international_recognition: QS Arab Rankings 2025: 161-170; THE Impact Rankings 2025: 1501+; Webometrics 2026: World Rank 3686, Country Rank 17

market_demand.employment_rate_estimate: Good for medical and engineering graduates; uncertain for other fields
market_demand.notes: Zarqa University serves a relatively underprivileged region. The university has partnerships with local industries and a Business Incubator Unit to support entrepreneurship and employability.

campus_facilities.accommodation_details: No on-campus student housing confirmed; the university does not list accommodation among its facilities
campus_facilities.scholarship_details: Multiple scholarship programs available: EDU-SYRIA (EU-funded for Syrian refugees), Social Security Corporation scholarships for children of retirees, 'We Rejoice in Hussein' scholarships for Zarqa residents, and other merit-based grants totaling approximately JD 2.5 million per term.
